newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama Q1 GDP grew 3.6 pct year-on-year - minister.
newsitem.headline: Panama Q1 GDP grew 3.6 pct year-on-year - minister.

text.p: Panama's gross domestic product grew 3.6 percent in real terms in the first quarter of 1997 compared to the first quarter of 1996, Planning and Economic Policy Minister Guillermo Chapman said.
"Preliminary estimates indicate that during the first quarter of 1997 GDP grew by 3.6 percent in real terms compared to the first quarter of 1996," Chapman told a news conference.
Ministry officials said it was the first time such figures had been released and no comparative figure was available for 1996.
Growth in the first quarter of 1997 "is the result of a strong expansion in the construction, electricity and ports activities," Chapman said.
If growth rates continue steady, the Panamanian economy should record overall growth of about 3.6 percent for 1997, he said.
